items.title: Biogen trims Apellis pipeline and R&D team after $5.6bn takeover
items.summary: Biogen plans to pause or terminate investment in most of Apellis’ legacy research programmes, while cutting some of its workforce.

items.title: FDA issues complete response letter to Sobi’s NASP for gout
items.summary: Sobi has received a CRL from the US FDA regarding its BLA for NASP, an investigational therapy intended for adults with uncontrolled gout.

items.title: Lilly’s Jaypirca receives CHMP positive opinion for CLL in Europe
items.summary: Lilly has received the CHMP of the EMA positive opinion for Jaypirca (pirtobrutinib) to treat chronic lymphocytic leukaemia (CLL) in adults.

items.title: Immunai and Boehringer partner to identify T-cell targets
items.summary: Immunai and Boehringer Ingelheim have entered into a multi-project collaboration to identify new T-cell targets in oncology and autoimmune diseases.

items.title: Tryngolza charts blockbuster course after FDA’s hypertriglyceridemia approval
items.summary: Ionis has forecast peak sales of $2bn for Tryngolza as it seeks to harness first-mover advantage.
